title: Well path, ladder plot and travelling cylinder
status: gate met - stations, plan/section paths, ladder plot, travelling cylinder, uncertainty ellipses and a per-offset cancellable scan

implementation.tools: TheTechIdea.OilGas.Wellbore — Trajectory.Compute, AntiCollision.Scan, LadderPlotView, TravellingCylinderView, SurveyUncertainty.ForWell

gates.AC-1 MD/TVD conversion matches DepthMapp: pass — the stations come from the tools' Trajectory.Compute; in the vertical leg (0–500 m) TVD equals MD to three decimals, and for the deviated well the last TVD is shorter than its MD with a non-zero north displacement
gates.AC-2 plan and section views draw the sam: pass — both projections are built from one station list: equal counts and identical MD sequences in order, so the two views cannot disagree
gates.AC-3 the ladder plot uses the same separ: pass — OgWellPath.Collision calls AntiCollision.Scan on two WellModels with surveys, datums and coordinates; the result carries offset points and a minimum separation factor (0.65 in the demo), and both the ladder and the cylinder render non-empty frames from that result. No separation maths is re-implemented.
gates.AC-4 uncertainty ellipses are drawn only: pass - OgWellPath.Uncertainty asks SurveyUncertainty.ForWell for a horizontal ellipse per station and keeps only those with a positive semi-major axis; the plan surface draws them and the page states the count or the reason. The default environment produces a model: the smoke run reports 6 ellipses for 7 stations (the surface station has zero covariance and is correctly omitted). Proven both ways with one renderer: supplying an ellipse changes the frame, clearing them restores it byte-for-byte.
gates.AC-5 a vertical well states the azimuth: pass — a vertical trajectory yields azimuth 0 with Assumed=true and a note naming the vertical well and the 0° assumption; the deviated demo is measured (no assumption) and lands at ~45°
gates.AC-6 changing the offset set cancels pen: pass - ComputeOffsets scans one offset well at a time and checks the token before each and after the last, so a cancel is observed at the next well boundary and a cancelled scan returns no partial result. The page cancels the previous CTS when the offset set changes and a superseded scan is never applied. Tests: cancel after the first offset stops progress at 1; a pre-cancelled token does no work; and a 300-offset scan superseded by the demo set returns null for the first and one offset for the second. The offset set became a real choice (one, two, none).

limits: Two demo surveys and two synthetic well models; no PPDM survey was read (DAT-02, G-08).
The plan and section views are a small polyline surface drawn by the desktop; the map-style plan view (MapView) and the section targets are not wired.
The surface station has zero covariance, so 6 of the 7 stations carry an ellipse; that is the model speaking, not a filter in the desktop.
The 'Export PDF' button writes the station table as a marker list through WellboreExport, not the path picture itself.
No 3D path view and no travelling-cylinder station picker; the cylinder uses the tools' default station.
